post_call_analysis_data.name: caller_name
post_call_analysis_data.description: The caller's first name, if given.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_number
post_call_analysis_data.description: The callback number the caller confirmed, in E.164 format (+1XXXXXXXXXX). Empty if not confirmed.

post_call_analysis_data.name: service_needed
post_call_analysis_data.description: What the caller needs, in a few words (for example: furnace not heating).

post_call_analysis_data.name: urgent
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller reported a gas smell, carbon monoxide alarm, no heat in cold weather, an active leak or flooding, a sewer backup, or a frozen or burst pipe.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if a visit or quote was booked or demo-booked on this call.

post_call_analysis_data.name: appointment_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: The booked day and time in plain words (for example: Tuesday 9:30 a.m.). Empty if nothing was booked.

post_call_analysis_data.name: sms_ok
post_call_analysis_data.description: True only if the caller clearly said yes to receiving a text message.

post_call_analysis_data.name: wants_donna
post_call_analysis_data.description: True if the caller asked how to get an AI receptionist like this for their own business.
